act-warmup.title: Warm-Up Routine
act-warmup.notes: Have students sit in their usual seats and follow the warm-up sheet in order.

act-video.title: Listening & Discussion
act-video.notes: Watch the full video, then lead a short discussion: what did you notice about dynamics and breath control?

slides.heading: Today's Topic
slides.body: We're reviewing time signatures. Click Next to move through each slide as a class.

slides.heading: 4/4 Time
slides.body: Four beats per measure, quarter note gets one beat. Clap the rhythm on the board together.

slides.heading: 3/4 Time
slides.body: Three beats per measure — think waltz. Try clapping this one too.

slides.heading: Wrap-Up
slides.body: Ask students to name a song in each time signature before moving on.
